text: NO EFFECT: Lysosomal activity did not differ between APOE4 and APOE3 iAstrocytes (E3 = E4). Both were significantly lower than APOE2 and APOE-KO.
description: Human isogenic APOE iPSC-derived astrocytes (day 44, EBiSC BIONi010 lines). Abcam flow-cytometry Lysosomal Intracellular Activity Assay. Points are replicate wells from three independent experiments. Caveat: measures lysosomal (not endosomal) proteolytic activity, which depends on pH but also on enzyme content and trafficking.

provenance.excerpt: Lysosomal activity in APOE3 and APOE4 was significantly lower than in APOE2 and APOE-KO cells (KO = E2 > E3 = E4) (Figure 4F).

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in lysosomal degradative activity) [NO EFFECT]

perturbed.variable: APOE genotype (isogenic APOE4 vs APOE3 iPSC-astrocytes)

measured.variable: Lysosomal intracellular activity (flow cytometry, self-quenched substrate kit), normalized to APOE3
